title: Cocones on the constant point diagram and their colimit criterion
statement:
Use the simplicial sets, Kan complexes, weak homotopy equivalences, coherent transformations and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix a universe $\mathcal W$, and let $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ be the infinity category of $\mathcal W$-small spaces defined in [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], formed in a containing universe. Let $K$ be a $\mathcal W$-small simplicial set, $Y$ a $\mathcal W$-small Kan complex, and $*=\Delta^0$ the one-point space. Write $\Delta_KZ$ for the constant diagram on $Z$. There is a natural equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal S_{\mathcal W})}(\Delta_K*,\Delta_KY)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(K,Y).$$
It identifies a coherent family of maps from the point to $Y$ with its family of points of $Y$, including all simplicial parameters. For a coherent cocone $\lambda:\Delta_K*\to\Delta_KY$, let $e_\lambda:K\to Y$ be the map corresponding to its point under this equivalence, up to homotopy. Then $\lambda$ is colimiting if and only if $e_\lambda$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. No nonemptiness or connectedness condition is imposed on $K$ or $Y$.

source.place: Kerodon Example 7.1.2.10 (03F8), using the copower criterion in Proposition 7.1.2.8 (03F6) and the spaces mapping comparison in Example 4.6.7.7 (06QR). The displayed cocone-space formula is the exponential adjunction for constant diagrams composed with that comparison. These are Kerodon tags, not Stacks tags; read online, not archived in literature/.
